public.instruction: Given a worker ID and unique task rows [id, status, worker_ids], return sorted IDs assigned to that worker with status PENDING or RUNNING. Ignore DONE/FAILED tasks and tasks owned only by other workers; a shared task belongs to every listed worker. This must hold whether there are many completed tasks, few worker tasks, or no tasks. State adapters expose exactly the pending/running union and its size. No live scheduler is run.

adaptations: Preserve the complete Worker.get_pending_tasks method under a minimal class shell; no Worker clock or scheduling lifecycle.
